decision: No justified untested structural intervention selected; preserve296 and all prior failures.

candidate_family_review.reason: Already tested with actual mask/action changes and slower paired laps; no new direct mechanism evidence.
Existing origin, speed, metric-motion and privileged-motion studies; residual error alone does not justify repackaging.
Direction and reference recovery already tested; new reliable legal signal and distinct pre-failure effect not established.
Current failed296 pre-contact path samples and targets remain road-supported; a specific false bridge and its causal effect have not been observed.
Mode exclusion, added state, matched-steering imitation and categorical joint control have already been tested; no new label objective is justified within this small screen.
Already directly tested on current296; do not reintroduce the same guard or reference recovery.

limitations: No statement that all perception, planning, or learning methods are impossible.
Existing sampled road support does not prove continuous hull feasibility or eliminate all perception errors.
This review is not a performance experiment or a new original-document mapping.
next_evidence_needed: Identify a distinct pre-failure information/representation error and show an existing-input, legal intervention changes it before spending native. No automatic new collection, fit, source search or intervention.
